upcomingNews.title: 🎉 Hedgehop v1.0.0 is Now Available!
upcomingNews.message:
# 🚀 Hedgehop v1.0.0 Official Release!

After months of development, we're thrilled to announce that **Hedgehop v1.0.0** is now officially available!

## 🎵 What's Included in v1.0.0:

### Core Features:
- **📱 Cross-Platform Support** - Available on Android and iOS
- **🎼 Extensive Sonic Music Library** - Organized by games and albums
- **🔄 Cross-Party Sync** - Listen together with friends in real-time
- **📊 Dynamic Statistics** - Track your listening habits and preferences
- **⭐ Favorites System** - Save and organize your favorite tracks
- **🔍 Advanced Search** - Find tracks quickly and efficiently

### User Interface:
- **📰 News & Updates** - Stay informed about new content and features
- **🛠️ Albums in Progress** - See what's currently being worked on
- **🗺️ Development Roadmap** - Track upcoming albums and features
- **📱 Responsive Design** - Optimized for both phones and tablets

### Technical Excellence:
- **⚡ High Performance** - Smooth playback and navigation
- **💾 Smart Caching** - Efficient data management
- **🔐 Secure Architecture** - Your data is protected
- **🌐 Real-time Updates** - Always get the latest content

## 🎮 Available Content:
Hedgehop v1.0.0 launches with tracks from multiple Sonic games, with more being added regularly through our development pipeline.

## 🙏 Thank You!
This release wouldn't have been possible without our amazing community of Sonic fans and music enthusiasts. Your feedback and support have been incredible!

> *"Gotta go fast... and listen to great music while doing it!"* 💙

Download Hedgehop v1.0.0 today and experience the ultimate Sonic music collection!

upcomingNews.title: 🚀 Exciting Features Coming Soon!
upcomingNews.message:
# 🎯 What's Next for Hedgehop?

We're continuously working on amazing new features to make your Hedgehop experience even better! Here's what's coming in the pipeline:

## 🔄 Upcoming Features:

### **🎮 XP System**
Earn experience points as you listen and unlock achievements! Track your progress and compete with friends on the leaderboards.

### **💬 Cross-Party Chat**
Chat in real-time with your friends while enjoying Cross-Party Sync. Share your thoughts, song recommendations, and create a true community listening experience.

### **🎵 Cross-Music in Cross-Party**
Share and discover music together! Listen to different tracks in sync and share what you're hearing with your party members.

### **🎵 Advanced Playlist Customization**
Take full control of your playlists with enhanced customization options. Add custom artwork, descriptions, and organize tracks exactly how you want them.

### **👤 User Profile Page**
Showcase your listening habits and achievements! Display your favorite tracks, stats, and personalize your profile with your unique style.

### **🎧 Album Request System**
Want a specific Sonic album or soundtrack? Submit requests and vote for albums you'd love to see added to Hedgehop. Community-driven content!

### **🎵 Collaborative Playlists**
Create playlists together with friends! Both add and manage tracks in shared playlists for the ultimate group listening experience.

### **🏆 Leaderboards & Achievements**
Compete with friends on various leaderboards and unlock special achievements and badges to showcase your dedication!

### **🎄 Seasonal Events & Celebrations**
Enjoy special holiday-themed events throughout the year! From Halloween parties to Christmas celebrations, Sonic music gets festive with limited-time events, exclusive playlists, and special rewards.

### **🌙 Dark Mode & Multiple Themes**
Customize the app appearance with different themes and true dark mode support for late-night listening sessions.

## 🙌 Your Feedback Matters!
We're always listening to your suggestions. Let us know what features you'd like to see next!

> *"The best is yet to come!"* 🎵

upcomingNews.title: 🎉 Hedgehop v1.0.1 is Now Available!
upcomingNews.message:
# 🚀 News Screen Enhancement in v1.0.1!

We've made significant improvements to the News screen to give you a better experience!

## ✨ What's Improved:

### **🔄 Auto-Refresh on Focus**
- The News screen now automatically refreshes whenever you navigate to it
- No need to manually reload the server anymore!
- Always get the latest updates instantly

### **🔘 Interactive Action Buttons**
- News items can now include action buttons
- Support for download, link, and navigation actions
- Customizable buttons directly from the news configuration
- Up to 2 buttons per news item for maximum flexibility

### **� Quick Reload Button**
- New reload button in the top-left corner of the News screen
- Force refresh the latest news and updates on demand
- Responsive design optimized for both phones and tablets

### **📱 Responsive Design**
- Full support for tablet mode with optimized button sizes
- Better spacing and visual hierarchy
- Improved modal for detailed news viewing

## 🎯 Why These Changes?
We wanted to make it easier for you to stay updated with the latest Hedgehop news and updates without any manual intervention. The improvements ensure you're always in sync with the latest developments!

## 🙏 Thank You!
These improvements were made based on community feedback. Keep the suggestions coming!

> *"Stay tuned for more exciting updates!"* 🎵

upcomingNews.title: 🎵 New Album Coming: Sonic CD
upcomingNews.message:
# 🕰️ Sonic CD Soundtrack Coming to Hedgehop!

Get ready to explore the past, present, and future with the iconic **Sonic CD** soundtrack!

## 🎮 About Sonic CD:

Originally released in 1993 for the Sega CD, Sonic CD is one of the most beloved entries in the Sonic franchise. This game revolutionized Sonic music with its unique dual-soundtrack system and time travel mechanics.

## 🎵 What Makes Sonic CD Special:

### **Dual Soundtracks:**
- **Japanese/European Soundtrack** - Composed by Naofumi Hataya and Masafumi Ogata
- **US Soundtrack** - Composed by Spencer Nilsen and David Young
- Two completely different musical experiences for the same game!

### **Time-Based Music:**
Each zone features different variations based on time periods:
- **Past** - Retro, organic sounds that evoke nostalgia
- **Present** - The main themes you hear during gameplay
- **Good Future** - Upbeat, triumphant melodies celebrating victory
- **Bad Future** - Dark, mechanical themes warning of danger

### **Iconic Tracks Include:**
- "Sonic Boom" - The legendary opening theme (US version)
- "You Can Do Anything" - The inspirational Japanese opening
- "Stardust Speedway" - One of the most memorable zones in Sonic history
- "Metallic Madness" - Epic final zone themes
- "Cosmic Eternity" - Beautiful ending themes

## 📀 What's Included:

The complete Sonic CD album features:
- ✨ Both JP/EU and US soundtracks
- 🕐 All time variations (Past, Present, Good Future, Bad Future)
- 🎼 Special stage music
- 🏆 Boss battle themes
- 🎬 Opening and ending vocals

## 🎯 Why This Album Matters:

Sonic CD features some of the most experimental and diverse music in the entire Sonic franchise. Whether you prefer the funky, energetic JP tracks or the atmospheric US compositions, this soundtrack is a masterpiece of video game music history!

> *"Sonic CD: Where past, present, and future collide in perfect harmony!"* 🕰️💙

### 💿 Fun Fact:
Sonic CD was one of the first games to feature CD-quality audio, making it a technical marvel of its time!
